author: reek
body: Acceptance probe (effect rows stage 0). An effectful function mapped inside a def that DECLARES [Console], with the effectful result act-bound before use. Under effect rows this is the row-polymorphic happy path (list-map's row variable instantiates to {Console}, which the signature covers) and must always compile and print. Guards stage 3 against over-rejection, and regression-tests CL 6508: the act-bound r must strip EffectfulTy through a resolved type variable, or list-length r trips CDX2031.
